login.title: Welcome back.
login.unverified: Confirm your email before signing in. Check your inbox.
login.genericError: Could not sign in. Please try again.
login.locked: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
login.pendingDeletion: This account is scheduled for deletion and access is locked. Reply to the deletion email and support will restore it.
login.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.description: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to create a new password.
forgot.sentDescription: If an account exists for {{email}}, you'll receive a link to reset your password.
forgot.sentHint: The link expires in 1 hour. Check spam / promotions.

reset.title: Create a new password.
reset.description: Choose a new password for your account. It replaces the previous one immediately.
reset.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Use something memorable.
reset.expiredDescription: This reset link is no longer valid. Request a new one to continue.
reset.doneDescription: Your password has been changed and every previous session was signed out. Sign in again with the new password.

errors.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 10 characters long.
errors.generic: Could not reset the password. Please try again.

register.title: Forge your table.
register.description: You're in within a few clicks. Start with Google or email.
register.emailHint: Used for login and account communications.
register.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Use something memorable.
register.consentLabel: I have read and accept the Terms of Use and the Privacy Policy.

errors.passwordTooShort: Your password must be at least 10 characters long.
errors.passwordTooLong: Your password can be at most 128 characters long.
errors.ageNotAllowed: You must be at least 13 years old to create an account.
errors.userExists: An account with this email already exists.
errors.userExistsOAuth: This email already has an account created with Google. Use Continue with Google.
errors.generic: Could not create the account. Check your details and try again.

verify.title: Verify your email.
verify.description: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Click the link to enter DM Forge.
verify.descriptionNoEmail: We sent a confirmation link to your email. Click the link to enter DM Forge.
verify.hint: It can take up to 2 minutes. Check spam / promotions.
verify.resendError: Could not resend right now. Try again in a moment.

menu.label: Account
menu.signOutError: Could not sign you out right now. Try again.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.subtitle: How you appear inside DM Forge.
profile.loadError: Could not load your profile. Reload the page.

photo.label: Profile picture
photo.hint: For now we use your initials.

email.label: Email
email.sub: Used to sign in. Changing it sends a verification to the new address.
email.sent: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Your current email keeps working until you confirm.
email.error: Could not start the change. Check the address and try again.

language.label: Interface language
language.sub: Applied right away and saved to your account.

privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.subtitle: Your data is yours. Take it with you, review what you consented to, and leave whenever you want.

export.label: Export my data
export.sub: A JSON file with your profile and your consent history.
export.expiresAt: The link expires on {{date}}. We also emailed it to you.
export.error: Could not prepare the export. Try again.

telemetry.label: Usage telemetry
telemetry.sub: Anonymous usage events. Turning it off stops collection immediately.

history.title: Consent history
history.sub: An immutable record of what you accepted and withdrew.
history.label: See the records
history.sub2: Type, version and date of every decision.

delete.label: Delete my account
delete.sub: The account is locked immediately and erased after 30 days.

dialog.title: Delete your account?
dialog.warning: Everything in your account — profile, campaigns and content — will be erased for good. There is no undo once the window closes.
dialog.grace: Your account stays locked for 30 days before the data is erased. Support can still restore it during that period.
dialog.confirmPassword: Type your password to confirm it is you.
dialog.confirmOAuth: Your account signs in with Google. Confirm to go ahead with the deletion.
dialog.error: Could not confirm. Check your password and try again.

pending.title: Account scheduled for deletion.
pending.due: Your data will be erased for good on {{date}}.
pending.restore: Access stays locked in the meantime. Changed your mind? Reply to the email we sent and support will restore your account before that date.
